content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"no","applies_why":"No: the judge rests UNDERDETERMINED on the defender's dropped live link, not on a single verse's failure to state a link or its contrary.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"Phrase single verse does not state a link or its contrary; reading 1 forbids any UNDERDETERMINED based on a verse's silence, reading 2 forbids only an express verse-silence ground and not a dropped-limb ruling.","why":"The stated ground is the absence of a live link after the defender dropped it, so K-S2's prohibition on using a single verse's non-statement as a ground is not violated."}
